summary: Verified the Scan DDT (AI) bugfix. Backend: 9 of 9 pytest tests pass. POST /api/magazzino/scan-ddt returns 200 with 2 extracted rows for a PNG image (image_base64) and for a reportlab PDF (file_base64 + application/pdf). ai_client.vision() works with only EMERGENT_LLM_KEY and returns 'OK'. It falls back to Emergent when _gemini_direct is mocked to raise 503, and also with a real invalid GEMINI_API_KEY=fake-key. With no keys it returns 500. Empty payload gives 400 and an unauthenticated call gives 401. Frontend: on /magazzino, Scan DDT (AI), choose fornitore, upload PNG, Analizza DDT shows the toast 'Trovati 2 articoli e 0 spese' and rows ddt-row-0/1 (12345 Anodo barra alluminio qty 2 netto 10.5; 67890 Filtro gasolio Racor qty 3 netto 24). The 'Totale verificato 93,00 €' banner is correct and no 'sovraccarico' error appears. 'Importa' was NOT pressed, so no warehouse data was created or changed. The production direct-Gemini path (real GEMINI_API_KEY with the new model list) could not be tested in preview.

minor.issue: Neither the Gemini model list nor the docstring/credentials file mention gemini-3-flash-preview, the model used on the Emergent path. If production has no EMERGENT_LLM_KEY and none of gemini-3.8-flash/3.6-flash/3.5-flash-lite/2.5-flash answers, the 503 comes back. Consider adding 'gemini-3-flash-preview' as the last fallback in the direct list.

An invalid API key (400 API_KEY_INVALID) is handled as 'model not available' because the body contains 'model'. It cycles through all models and then raises 503 'sovraccarico' instead of a clear 'chiave Gemini non valida' error (unless the Emergent fallback rescues it).

issues: The Q.tà number input is ~37px wide: its value (2, 3) is in the DOM but looks EMPTY on screen at 1920px. Widen the column (min-w ~56px) or reduce the padding.
The Codice and Categoria inputs are truncated ('1234', 'Carbur').

action_items: Widen the Q.tà (and Codice/Categoria) inputs in the ScanDDTDialog table: the quantity looks empty
Optional: add gemini-3-flash-preview to the direct Gemini fallback list; return a specific error for an invalid API key
critical_code_review_comments: The ai_client.vision fallback logic is correct (502/503 lead to Emergent)
In ai_client.py the module docstring and testo() priority differ (Emergent first for testo, Gemini first for vision). Fine, but document it.
seed_data_creation: None. No fornitori or articoli created; Import was not pressed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login is password-only 'admin'. Scan endpoint: /api/magazzino/scan-ddt. The test file generates the PNG/PDF itself; the AI call takes ~10-20s. The dialog's testids are btn-scan-ddt, dialog-scan-ddt, input-ddt-file, ddt-select-fornitore, btn-ddt-scan, ddt-row-N, btn-ddt-import.
rca of the issue: Production used GEMINI_API_KEY directly and the old model list ended with gemini-2.0-flash, which Google retired (404). With every model failing, the 503 'sovraccarico' was raised. Fix: new model list plus fallback to EMERGENT_LLM_KEY on 502/503. Verified in preview through the Emergent path and through the mocked and invalid-key fallback.
